title: feat(skills): derive the compatibility majors and metadata.version from the workspace version
body:
Fixes #22658
Clause-②: no

Ruling A on #22649 (record 6096124407, maintainer 「22649 同意 A」): the `compatibility:` line and each skill's `metadata.version` derive from the package version instead of being kept by hand. This is PR 2 of the two the card allows — the derivation and the ten regenerated frontmatters (Tier H: `skills/**`). PR 1 (`claude/issue-22658-skills-package`) adds the `@objectstack/skills` package; this PR does not depend on it merging (see the version source below). No `skills/**` path moves; no skill's teaching changes — the ten diffs are one `version:` line each.

## What changes

- `scripts/check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs` — the gate that already reconciled every `@objectstack/PKG N.x` pin against the workspace manifests now also reconciles `metadata.version`: every `SKILL.md` must carry exactly the fixed group's version, read off `@objectstack/spec`'s manifest (`CATALOG_VERSION_PACKAGE`); an absent stamp is red, a stale one is red naming file / declared / actual / fix, and a workspace without that package is red rather than "nothing to derive". A new `--fix` leg is the one writer: it rewrites each pin's major to the cited package's current workspace major (an inline scalar or a folded block scalar) and `metadata.version` to that version, writes only the files that moved, then runs the check; it invents no structure (a file with no `version:` key comes back unchanged and is named). Every prescription that used to say "edit the line" now names `--fix`; the header and the report footer say the line ships inside `@objectstack/skills` and from `main` as the `next` channel. The self-test grows from 18 to 27 pinned batteries: R9 stale stamp, R10 absent stamp, R11 the exempt (unpinned) upgrade skill is stamped too, R12 the anchor package missing, and five `--fix` derivation cases (both lines rewritten with every other byte kept, no-op on a derived file, a folded-block pin, no invented structure, an unknown package left for the check). R1's prescription regex moved with the text.
- `package.json` (root) — the `version` script runs `node scripts/check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs --fix` after `changeset version`, beside `sync-protocol-version.mjs` and `sync-template-versions.mjs`: the Version Packages PR carries the restamped frontmatters, so `main` never sits red here between a bump and a hand edit, and the maintainer's own merge of that PR is the Tier H act for `skills/**`.
- `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs` — a `NOT_DRIVER_MANAGED` row (`skills/*/SKILL.md`, `gen: version`, root owner): the `--fix` makes the root `version` script a generator in `git-merge-regen`'s population, and the recorded answer to "discard both sides and re-run" is no — two derived lines inside hand-written prose; a text conflict stays a human's, the two lines re-stamp on the next `--fix`. `pnpm check:merge-driver`: `all 43 generator(s) across 81 manifest(s) have a recorded disposition`.
- `skills/*/SKILL.md` (10 files) — regenerated by `--fix`, never by hand: `metadata.version` `"1.0"` / `"1.2"` / `"1.3"` ×4 / `"1.4"` ×3 / `"4.4"` → `"17.7.0"`; 10 insertions, 10 deletions, nothing else. Every `compatibility:` pin was already at the workspace major (`17.x`), so those lines are byte-identical. `skills/README.md`'s generated block does not carry the version; it is unchanged (`check:skill-docs` green).

## The version source, measured

The PM's mechanism assumption named two possible sources and asked which exists on `main`: `packages/skills/package.json` does not exist at this branch's base (`243dd3c62`); `packages/spec/package.json` does. The derivation reads `@objectstack/spec` — the fixed group's anchor, the package every published skill's `compatibility:` line cites — and `@objectstack/skills` carries the identical version by the `fixed` group (`check-changeset-fixed` holds the membership). So this PR is green on its own and stays correct whichever of the two PRs lands first; the alternative (read `packages/skills/package.json`) would red `check:skill-compatibility` on this branch until PR 1 is on `main`, and red `main` if this PR landed first. The constant is one line to change if the maintainer prefers the literal package.

The gate had no hand-maintained version constant to replace: it already reconciled pins against the workspace manifests. What was hand-kept was the frontmatter itself; that is what `--fix` and the `version` script now own.

## Reverse verification on the live tree (restored, proven)

On `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md` (HEAD blob `5e7ca000…`), with a trap restoring through `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`:

- leg 1, the `version:` line deleted → `check-skill-compatibility-version` exit 1: `cannot read metadata.version: frontmatter metadata: map has no version: key`, naming the file and `--fix`;
- leg 2, the stamp set to `"4.4"` → exit 1: `declared: metadata.version "4.4"` / `actual: @objectstack/spec 17.7.0 (packages/spec/package.json)` / `fix: run … --fix`;
- leg 3, `--fix` → `1 of 10 SKILL.md file(s) rewritten`, exit 0;
- restored: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status` clean; the gate green again (`10 metadata.version stamp(s) all equal @objectstack/spec 17.7.0`).

## Gates run (exit codes captured before any pipe)

Derived on the changed set and reconciled with `--ran`: 51 derived, 51 run, 0 UNRUN; every family exit 0. Named by the card and all green: `check:skill-compatibility` (self-test 22 check cases + 5 derivation cases + 6 declaration cases; run: 10 files, 11 pins, 10 stamps), `check-skills-token-ratchet` (+ self-test), `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:skill-examples` (262 prose examples type-check, on the built tree), `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-frame-freshness`, `check:skill-top-level-keys`, `check:pm-governed-merges` (+ `pm-governed-prose`), `check:merge-driver`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:role-word`, `check:self-test-wired`, `check:ratchet-remedy-authority`, `check:dts-closure` / `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` / `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` / `check:lean-entry-closure` on a full build under the verify lock (72 tasks, `VERDICT command-exit 0`, held 463s), `check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier; its reading is in the report comment). Lint at `5567d606c`: eslint `--format json` over the two JavaScript files touched — 2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings; the config enables no type-aware linting, so no untouched file's verdict moves.

Token ratchet reading, before → after (`check-skills-token-ratchet`, all within ceilings, exit 0): `objectstack-data/SKILL.md` 6127 → 6128 of 6128 (headroom 1 → 0), `objectstack-automation` 5783 → 5783 (headroom 2), `objectstack-platform` 5830 → 5831 (headroom 2), `objectstack-ui` 3847 → 3848 (headroom 8), `objectstack-upgrade` 6184 → 6185 (headroom 8); the other five gain one token with wide headroom. No ceiling was touched. A future bump that lengthens the version string (`17.10.0`) may cost one more token on `objectstack-data`; that would be the `version` script's run, and the ceiling is the maintainer's to move.

## Acceptance notes

- The maintainer named no new standalone gate and none is added: the derivation lives inside the existing gate as its `--fix` leg, and the self-test rides the existing `check:skill-compatibility` alias.
- `skip-changeset`: nothing publishes from this PR (`skills/**` reaches npm only through `@objectstack/skills`'s build, whose changeset is PR 1's; the gate and the ledger are repo tooling; the root manifest is private).
- Landing order is free, but the stamps are the ones a consumer reads: the first release after both PRs publishes `metadata.version: "17.x.y"` inside `@objectstack/skills`.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- 改了什么:十个 `SKILL.md` 里的 `metadata.version` 不再手写,由 `check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs --fix` 从工作区版本派生(本次全部变成 `"17.7.0"`;`compatibility:` 的 `17.x` 已与工作区一致,一字未动);门禁同时校验这一行,发版时 `pnpm run version` 自动重打。
- 为什么改:裁决 A 要求技能目录随版本发运,版本号就不能靠人记——以前每个技能各写一个 `"1.3"`、`"4.4"`,与任何真实版本无关。
- 风险与代价(含回滚):十个受管文件各改一行;每次发版的 Version Packages PR 会多出这十行(由你手合)。回滚 = 还原这三个脚本改动,十行自动回到旧值。
- 席位意见:(留空)
- 你要做的:在这张 PR 上给一个 APPROVED review(Tier H:`skills/**`);之后由席位落地。
